comparison_X1_vs_X2.summary: Neither result contradicts any reference and neither loses one outright. X2 fully keeps two more references (C04, C05) than X1; X1 keeps one C08 facet (reader-side write enforcement) that X2 lacks. X2 is stronger on schema/spec separation, writer-rollout pinning, plate truthfulness, RO-Crate, stack conflict and explicit decision surfacing. Unsupported assertions are few and low-severity in both (X1: 2, X2: 3). Per SCORING, no net score is computed and counts do not offset losses.
